description: This Java source file defines the 'DeleteAclEntry' class, which represents a command for deleting an ACL entry associated with a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and implements logic for payload construction and resource identification within the API.

classes.name: DeleteAclEntry
classes.description: A command class that deletes a specific ACL entry for a Thing, identified by an AuthorizationSubject. It extends AbstractCommand and implements ThingModifyCommand, with methods for creating instances from JSON or parameters, and for serializing its payload.

methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command, including the thing ID and authorization subject.
